description: Source code implementing a git graph visualization module with functions for rendering commit graphs, handling colors, and managing graph state transitions.

classes.name: column
classes.description: Represents a column in the commit graph, holding a reference to a commit and its display color.

classes.name: git_graph
classes.description: Encapsulates the state and data structures for rendering a commit graph, including columns, mappings, and rendering states.

classes.name: graph_line
classes.description: Represents a line of graph output, including a buffer and its width.

methods.name: graph_show_strbuf
methods.description: Prints the contents of a strbuf line by line, optionally displaying the graph before each line.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit along with its graph representation.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Displays a single-line representation of a commit with its graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs a padding line in the graph, used for spacing.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs remaining lines of the graph for a commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Displays the commit message with the associated graph lines.
